attr.title: Paciencia
attr.desc: Classic Klondike solitaire in the style of Windows 3.1, with original artwork. Move the cursor with the left stick or D-Pad and drag cards with A. Draw 1 or Draw 3, scoring, undo and the bouncing cards victory animation.
attr.inst: Ready to run. No additional setup required. A drags cards (a plain click sends a card to the foundations), B makes a smart move, Y undoes, L1 switches Draw 1 / Draw 3, R1 plays every card it can to the foundations, Start deals a new game, Select quits.
